{{Quote|I'm Uli. I maintained machines in the Empire's Project Treshold, an experimental, uh, training program in the art of interrogation.|[[Uli Zhensi]]|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Art of Interrogation|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>}}
'''Project Threshold''' was a program run by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that dealt with creative innovative [[Torture/Legends|torture]] machinery. Workers such as [[Uli Zhensi]], [[Bola (individual)|Bola]], [[Uthril]] and [[Nug]] worked with the machines for the Empire before becoming disgusted with the Imperials and defecting to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], asking a citizen to sabotage the project for their sake.<ref name="TOR" />
